title: Courthouse Wedding in Dallas: Real Cost & Steps (2026)
description: Courthouse wedding in Dallas: $161 in fees: license $81 + ceremony $80, per the official pages. Wait, ID and booking steps. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
refresh_note: Courthouse pages are re-checked every 3 months.
answer_html:
As of Oct 28, 2026, a courthouse wedding in Dallas costs $161 in official fees: $81 for the marriage license (Dallas County Clerk) and $80 for the civil ceremony (Justice of the Peace court 2-2 by appointment, cash only; other Dallas County courts charge $60 to $150).

steps: Fill in the Dallas County marriage license application online and write down the order number it gives you.
Both of you go to the County Clerk's Records Building (500 Elm St., Suite 2100) with photo ID and your Social Security numbers, and pay the $81 license fee (no personal checks).
Wait 72 hours after the license is issued before the ceremony, unless a district judge waives it or you hold a Twogether in Texas certificate.
Book a ceremony with a Dallas County Justice of the Peace court; each court sets its own fee (JP 5-1 $60, JP 2-2 $80 by appointment, JP 3-1 $150 on its pages).
Hold the ceremony within 90 days of the day the license was issued, or the license expires.

faq.q: How to get married at the courthouse in Dallas?
faq.a: Fill in the Dallas County marriage license application online and keep the order number. Both of you go to the County Clerk's Records Building (500 Elm St., Suite 2100) with photo ID and pay the $81 license fee (no personal checks), wait 72 hours, then book a ceremony with a Justice of the Peace court.

faq.q: How much is it to get married at the courthouse in Dallas?
faq.a: As of Oct 28, 2026, the license costs $81 and each Justice of the Peace court sets its own ceremony fee: $60 at JP 5-1, $80 by appointment at JP 2-2 and $150 at JP 3-1. That makes $141 to $231 in fees, depending on the court.

faq.q: Can you get married the same day in Dallas?
faq.a: Not by default: Texas law requires 72 hours after the license is issued. A district judge can waive the wait, and the Dallas County Clerk's page says a Twogether in Texas certificate waives it and takes $60 off the license fee.

faq.q: Can I get married at a courthouse in Texas?
faq.a: Yes: in Dallas County, ceremonies are performed by Justice of the Peace courts, each with its own hours and fee. For example JP 2-2 marries couples Monday to Friday from 10:30a to 3:30p for $80 cash only by appointment.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to get married at a courthouse?
faq.a: The official fees here run $141 to $231. The lowest Dallas venue price we verified for a group of 10 or more is $450 (Blush Event Garden: Classic elopement), so the courthouse is the cheaper start; compare both pages before you decide.
